findings.rationale: The jump security group allows inbound TCP port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing an administrative shell to the internet.
The escalation role is assumable and carries an attached privileged policy, so a caller can inherit elevated permissions.
The fixture links the internet-reachable jump security group to role escalation through sts AssumeRole, creating a direct path from exposed shell access to identity takeover.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/connectivity.json, edge sg-jump to role-escalate via sts AssumeRole
